parsed.basis: Gamprin is a small rural municipality in Liechtenstein where the visitor encounters the same national regime as elsewhere in the country, with no region-specific information distinguishing it from the national picture. Same-sex relations are lawful and sexual orientation is covered by anti-discrimination and incitement protections, while gender identity has no equivalent protected ground, there is no procedure for changing a Liechtenstein-issued gender marker, and no law restricts access to sex-segregated facilities on the basis of gender identity. Official and church-led conservatism has at times been less protective than the statutes, but no local enforcement, border, police or service practice specific to Gamprin is known.
